source: IPCC AR5, 100-year GWP (WG1 Chapter 8, Table 8.A.1) — corrected 2026-09-18 against the actual primary-source PDF (not a secondary summary): R-32 675 -> 677 and R-134a 1430 -> 1300. The 675/1430 figures are the AR4 (2007) values, which are extremely widely miscited across HVAC/EPA/regulatory references (including the EU F-Gas Regulation, which still officially uses AR4 GWPs) as if they were AR5 — this file inherited that same mix-up. R-410A (2088) and SF6 (23,500) were independently confirmed correct for AR5 and left unchanged. R-22 was NOT re-verified against the primary table this pass (that table's HCFC-22 row extracted with an implausible lifetime value, suggesting a parsing/alignment error) — kept at 1810 on the strength of an earlier, cleaner citation rather than risk a bad number from unreliable extraction.

ar6Alternative.note: If the team wants to move to AR6 instead: R-32 -> 771, R-134a -> 1530, SF6 -> 24,300. R-410A and R-22 are unchanged under AR6. Verified against the GHG Protocol reference table, 2026-09-17.

phaseOutNotice.R-22: R-22 (HCFC-22) is being phased out under the Montreal Protocol in Singapore. New top-ups indicate ageing equipment approaching end-of-life — flag for replacement rather than repeated top-up.
